name: monorepo-turbo
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Monorepo with Turborepo
description: One repo for your whole product: pick the web app (Next.js or Vite), and optionally a mobile app with Expo, an API with Hono and docs with Starlight. Shared UI and config packages, and cached builds with Turborepo.
finalize:
[ ! -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ] || grep -q '^allowBuilds:' pnpm-workspace.yaml || printf '
allowBuilds:
  esbuild: true
' >> pnpm-workspace.yaml

choices.label: Next.js
choices.description: App Router, using the shared @repo/ui package.

choices.label: Vite + React
postInstall: rm -rf apps/web && npx create-vite@latest apps/web --template react-ts --no-interactive && npm pkg set name=web --prefix apps/web

options.label: More apps
options.description: The product's other apps, each in its own apps/ folder.

choices.label: API (Hono)
choices.description: Node.js API with Hono in apps/api.
postInstall: npx -y tiged honojs/starter/templates/nodejs apps/api && rm -f apps/api/pnpm-workspace.yaml && npm pkg set name=api --prefix apps/api

choices.label: Mobile (Expo)
choices.description: iOS and Android app with Expo in apps/mobile.
postInstall: npx create-expo-app@latest apps/mobile --template blank-typescript --no-install && npm pkg set name=mobile --prefix apps/mobile

choices.label: Docs (Starlight)
choices.description: Documentation site with Astro Starlight in apps/docs.
postInstall: npx create-astro@latest apps/docs --template starlight --no-install --no-git --yes && npm pkg set name=docs --prefix apps/docs

instructions:
## How to work here

- It's a monorepo: apps live in `apps/` (`web`, `api`, `mobile`, `docs`) and shared code in `packages/` (`@repo/ui`, `@repo/typescript-config`, `@repo/eslint-config`).
- Run tasks from the root with Turborepo: `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run dev`, `pnpm run lint` (or `npm`/`bun`, depending on the project's package manager). For a single app: `pnpm turbo run dev --filter=web`.
- Dependencies are added to the app or package that uses them, not to the root (except tools like `turbo` or `prettier`).
- Anything several apps use goes into a package in `packages/`; never copy it from one app to another.
- Before finishing: `pnpm run build` from the root.
